title: A New Approach to Probabilistic Rounding Error Analysis
publisher: SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing, Vol. 41, No. 5, pp. A2815-A2835
author: Nicholas J. Higham; Theo Mary
locator: Abstract: conventional worst-case backward-error constant gamma_n = n*u/(1-n*u), with n the operation count and u the unit roundoff; the paper's contribution develops probabilistic relaxations.
license_or_permission: Publisher identifies the article as open access under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; consult the publisher licence text for redistribution terms.
notes: Used only as a source for the conventional gamma_n worst-case floating-point accumulation bound. It does not justify the ENE-01 analyst-supplied maximum stored-energy, net-power, trajectory propagation or time-grid error bounds, nor does it provide CNC machine parameters or acceptance criteria.
